metadata.description: e2a plugins for Claude Code — open-source email API for applications and AI agents

plugins.name: e2a
plugins.description: Open-source email API for applications and AI agents — transactional sending from any product, per-agent two-way inboxes, HITL approval, structured SPF/DKIM/DMARC evidence, and a queryable event log. 79 MCP tools over hosted streamable HTTP with OAuth.

plugins.name: e2a-labs
plugins.description: Experimental Agentify, Autopilot, and Tether workflows for e2a. Requires the core e2a plugin for MCP tools and authentication.
